items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And he wanted to record with me. We wanted to do stuff together, but the problem was time ran out.

ctx.x: And he wanted to record with me. We wanted to do stuff together, but the problem was time ran out. It’s always something like that happens. He heard it. He used to play down the street from me, after I left West 3rd Street - I mean, Sheraton Square - I moved over on West 3rd Street where I had a whole building. It was a loft building, but I had four floors above, a pharmacy downstairs, and I had the four floors above it. Then I could have my music. I had a ping pong table room. You guys aren’t rough in that…
